description: Read the AITune sidecar's current GPU and CPU load: utilisation, memory and temperature. Pass history true to get the readings over the last duration_minutes (1 to 1440, default 60) instead. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

duration_minutes.description: How far back the history goes, in minutes. Defaults to 60.

history.description: Return the readings over time instead of the current ones.

name: get_aitune_system_stats
